info.title: INSYS Core API
info.description: Multi-tenant insurance administration platform. The tenant comes from the bearer token's tenant_id claim. Every response carries X-Correlation-Id: the caller's when it sent a valid one, else a new one; errors repeat it as correlationId.

get.summary: List dead-lettered messages
get.description: Messages whose delivery failed after all retries (INT-006), oldest first, with cursor pagination.

get.summary: Get a dead-lettered message
get.description: Returns the dead letter with its original event envelope. The ETag is required to replay or discard it.

post.summary: Replay a dead-lettered message
post.description: Delivers the original event to its consumers again. Consumers skip events they already processed (INT-005, INT-006).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last GET (row_version, DBA-011). Missing gives 428; stale gives 412.

post.summary: Discard a dead-lettered message
post.description: Closes the dead letter without delivering it (INT-006).

parameters.name: If-Match

post.summary: Retry a parked delivery at the parking job's next pass
post.description: ADR-022 decision 4, trigger 3. The consumer's inbox skips the event if it was already applied, so a retry never applies it twice.

post.summary: Retry every parked delivery in the tenant for one code
Discard a delivery without delivering it, with a reason

Search parties
post.description: By name (at least 3 characters, anywhere in the display name), an exact identifier (document type, country and number), a role in effect today, and status; at least one, all that are given must match. Results are summaries ordered by ID with cursor paging; open a party for its details. Every search is written to the party access log (PTY-003, PTY-005): who, when, the filters and the number of results, with an identifier by its keyed hash only. POST, so the identifier number is never in a URL.

post.summary: Resolve a portal registration that matched an existing party: LINK it to that party, or confirm it as NEW
post.description: External-user access §6. The party must be waiting for review (reviewStatus PENDING_REVIEW). existingPartyId is needed only for a registration made before its match was recorded, and must be the matched party otherwise. Completes asynchronously (GAP-027): the PARTY_MATCH_RESOLUTION approval appears in Workflow. Approved, a LINK merges the registration into the existing party (party.PartiesMerged) and NEW confirms it, and the review task is closed; rejected, the registration is back to PENDING_REVIEW.

get.summary: List audit events
get.description: The tenant's audit trail of sensitive operations and denied requests, newest first (IAM-006, TEN-005).

get.summary: Get a record's history
get.description: Every change to one record, newest first, for the record action bar. targetType is the record's aggregate type as the API names it (UserAccount, Tenant, Party, LifePolicy ...) and targetId its ID. Each command or event policy that adds or changes the record leaves an entry: its own audit entry (IAM-006), or a RECORD_CHANGED entry naming the command. Failed attempts at audited operations are included with their outcome.

code.description: The stable error code (the error code catalogue), for example VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED or NOT_READY. Present on every error except a malformed request (400, 405, 415) rejected before an endpoint runs.

errors.description: Validation failures (422): field name to its messages.

correlationId.description: The same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header, on every error (GAP-007).

traceId.description: The server's trace identifier, for support.

detailLanguage.description: Present when the detail stayed in English because the catalogue has no detail in the title's language; its value is then "en".

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is stable and never localised; `title` and `detail` follow the request's language.

X-Correlation-Id.description: The request's correlation ID: the caller's X-Correlation-Id when it sent a valid one, else a new one. Errors carry it in correlationId too.

Content-Language.description: The language of the error's title (docs/specs/addenda/localisation.md §4).

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

bearer.description: OIDC access token carrying sub and tenant_id. Permissions come from IAM role assignments.
